draft.subject: A quick first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Following up on my note last week — no pressure if the first week got busy. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the easiest place to start. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and get that first project set up with you — just reply with a time that works.

Best,
Nadia
